lines.text: Every day, business happens in chats.
Orders. Payments. Leads. Voice notes.
For millions of businesses, WhatsApp isn't just a messaging app. It's where the work gets done.
The numbers are staggering.
WhatsApp now has more than three billion users every month. More than five hundred million of them are in India.
The WhatsApp Business app has crossed two hundred million monthly users. And ninety-one percent of online adults in India chat with a business every week.
Every day, people send an average of seven billion voice messages.

Yet sixty-two percent of workers say they struggle with too much time spent searching for information. And one survey found professionals spend more than nine hours a week, manually transferring data.
So here's the gap.
Your business information is buried in DMs and groups.
You scroll through thousands of messages, looking for one customer.
You copy every lead, payment and order into a spreadsheet. By hand. Every day.
You export your chats into an AI assistant, just to understand what's going on, and hit a wall.
Voice notes. Payment screenshots. Mixed-language messages. None of it fits neatly into a sheet.
WhatsApp was built for a world before AI.
Introducing Infera.
The intelligent inbox.
Infera reads your chats, and turns every message, voice note and attachment into clean, structured rows. Automatically. In the background.

lines.text: Meet Collections: a new form of Sheets.
One row per order, with the customer, purchase, quantity, value and status.
And it updates itself.
A payment screenshot arrives, and Anjali's order is marked paid.
A voice note becomes a brand-new row.
Click any row, and see the exact message it came from.
Setting up takes sixty seconds.
First, scan a QR code to link WhatsApp, the same way WhatsApp Web works. No new number. No migration.
Then, just ask: find all orders from my chats for the last month.
Infera reads your chats, designs the table, and proposes the fields. Accept, and the collection fills itself.

lines.text: Now ask anything. Who asked about the blue running shoes?
You get a proper answer, cited and linked to the original messages.
Under the hood, Infera runs a continuous pipeline.
lines.tts: Under the hood, Infurra runs a continuous pipeline.

lines.text: Messages, voice notes, photos and documents sync from your linked device, and your history is backfilled as far as WhatsApp makes it available.
Voice notes are transcribed. Text in payment screenshots and invoices is read.
Mixed-language chats are understood: English with Hindi, Malayalam, Tamil, Bengali, and Hinglish.
Agents run only on the chats you choose. They extract each detail into typed fields, and write one row per order, lead or payment.
Every row links back to its source. And every new message updates the right row.
All of it, encrypted.
Messages are encrypted before they're stored in the cloud, and decrypted only on the devices you've signed in to.
You choose which chats are read. Your data is never sold, and never trained on.
No more scrolling. No more copy-paste. No more exports.
Infera works where business already happens, and keeps working around the clock.

One account, synced across Windows, Mac, iOS and Android.
WhatsApp is live today. Gmail, Slack and more are on the way.
Your first table, in sixty seconds. And your first week is free.
Infera. The intelligent inbox.
